substantiveMarketFinding.claim: The prior-session value-area low and the Donchian support are NOT the same level on this cohort.
substantiveMarketFinding.measured: pTpoVAL_donchianLo_spread at 2026-09-10T17:19Z across BTC ETH SOL BNB XRP DOGE LINK AVAX HYPE PEPE: 2.31, 3.43, 4.36, 4.67, 4.96, 5.21, 5.36, 8.00, 8.01, 12.19 percent. Median about 5. Not one inside the 0.5 percent tolerance.
substantiveMarketFinding.soWhat: The design premise - that the volume-profile edge and the structure level coincide, so a TPO read can qualify an sr_at_support firing - is false most of the time here. This is the first thing the TPO work has established about the MARKET rather than about the platform. N=10, one instant.

honestLimitations: STILL CANNOT ROUTE. All 84 signalRules remain at allocation 0 and minAggregateScore stays 0.99. changedAxes never included SETUP_GATES on either apply. The 33.56 USDC remains untouchable through this path.

THE DOWN VERDICT IS THE BASE STATE, NOT AN EDGE. BELOW_VALUE_NO_STRUCTURE is TRUE whenever price is below prior value and the bridge tolerance does not fire - which, per the measurement above, is essentially always. A verdict that fires on everything discriminates nothing.

THE 0.5 PERCENT BRIDGE TOLERANCE IS WRONG BY AN ORDER OF MAGNITUDE and was deliberately NOT re-fitted. Re-fitting it to ten observations at one instant would repeat exactly the error this project exists to avoid. The column is live and logging; set it from a real distribution.

THE PROPOSED ENGINE WAS NOT APPLIED. Three independent adversarial reviews of a six-rule Bollinger/divergence/FVG scorecard all returned REJECT. The decisive argument: no TPO metric feeds any of the 84 signals, so that engine would route on Bollinger bands while the TPO half stayed decoration, and no outcome could distinguish 'value location works' from 'value location is decoration'.
UNIVERSE IS NOW 10, DOWN FROM 36, forced by the byte cap. The read-only panel logger still covers all 36 because preview is not subject to that cap.

THE STRATEGY DESCRIPTION IS NOW PARTLY STALE: it still describes only the above/inside/below tagging and undersells the two new bridge columns. It remains accurate on the load-bearing claim - that the strategy cannot score or route.
